_comment: Migrated 2026-09-04 from errors/established.json, which holds this as two entries
(PcieSetupTestCase and CheckPcieTopology) and says outright that they are one thing:
the sheet calls it PcieSetupTestCase, the controllers log CheckPcieTopology.
WHY code IS null. Neither name resolves to a single code. In errors/catalogue.json
PcieSetupTestCase carries 2 candidate codes (TH-PCIE-0008, TH-PCIE-0009) and
CheckPcieTopology carries 9. The established root cause is a statement about the
test case, not about any one of those codes, so pinning it to one would be inventing
a diagnosis. This is the case- file form doing the job it exists for.
EVIDENCE. established.json says this was 'Reported in Slack', but no permalink was
captured at the time. Under SCHEMA.md rule 3 an unrecorded source is omitted rather
than reconstructed, so only the Jira reference is listed. If somebody finds the
thread, add it -- do not guess at it.

rootCauses.statement: The PCIe setup case fails when the harness cannot enumerate the topology it expects -- a proxy that has not come up, an inventory command that returned nothing parseable, or a topology file that does not match the server being tested. None of those are the module: the discovered device count or parent/child topology not matching the expected server topology is a statement about the expectation as much as about the hardware.

correctiveActions.action: Confirm the expected topology for this chassis build before touching the DUT, and confirm the RPC proxy is up. Re-run; escalate only if it reproduces on a second station.
